verdict.rationale: Running a local shell is a fair question for a terminal/SSH client, so the axis applies. However, every terminal feature in the evidence (snippets, broadcast, workspaces, autocomplete) is described for remote host sessions. The only local capability mentioned is local file browsing in the SFTP dual-pane view, not a local shell. With no evidence that the app runs local UNIX commands such as ls, grep, tar or curl, the verdict is none.
